content: Sa7oolikka Isttifaanose hayqon isttara qofan gaaggides; he wode Yerusalaamen diza ammanizayta bolla wolqqama goodeteththi dendides. Hawaareti attaafe ammanizayti wuri Yuhuda awuraajjaninne Samaariya awuraajja ubbaan laalettida.
Ayana ooson minni eqqida asati Isttifaanose moogidi izas daro yeekkida.
Sa7ooli qasse Woosa Keeth dhayssanaas gixxi dendides; ammaniza asaa issaa issaa keeththe gelidi maccassatanne addeta goochchi goochchi kessidi qasho keeth gelththides.
Piliphoosi Samaariya Deren Markkattida Mishiraachcho Qaala
Laalettidayti wuri ba bidason bidason Xoossa qaala yootida.
Piliphoosikka Samaariya geetettiza katamaa wodhdhidi asaas Kirstoosa sabbakides.
Daro derey Piliphoosi ooththiza malaata be7idi izi yootiza qaalaa wozinappe lo7eththi siyides.
Tuna ayanatikka daro asappe waassi waassi kezida; daro toho silatinne wobbetikka paxida.
Hessa gishshas he katamaa asay daro ufayettides.
Gido attiin hessafe kase he katamayin maro marotidi Samaariya asaa daro malalisizaaz ooththiza issi Simoona geetettiza maroy dees; izikka bana gita asa mala qoodizaade.
Asay wuri guuththatappe gitata gakkanaas wurikka, «Hayssi addezi gita wolqqama geetettiza Xoossa wolqqa» gishe izi gizayssa wursi wozinappe siyees.
Daro wode ba maroteththa ooson asaa malalisida gishshas asay iza wozinappe kaallishe gam7ides.
Gido attiin Piliphoosi Xoossa Kawoteththa gishshassinne Yesus Kirstoosa gishshas sabbakidayssa siyidi ammanida maccassaynne attumasay xammaqettides.
Simoonikka ammanidi xammaqettides; Piliphoosakka kaalli biidi haniza gita malaataa be7idi malalettides.
Yerusalaamen diza Hawaareti Samaariya asay Xoossa qaala ekkidi ammanidayssa siyidi Phexroosanne Yohannisa isttako kiittida.
Isttika Samaariya gakkidi ammanida asay Xillo Ayana ekkana mala asaas woossida.
Gaasoykka he wode istti coo Yesusa sunththan xammaqettida attiin buro Xillo Ayanay isttafe issaade bollaka wodhdhibeenna.
Hessa gishshas Phexroosinne Yohannisi ba kushe asaa bolla woththiin asay Xillo Ayana ekkides.
Simoonikka Hawaareti kushe woththi woossiin Xillo Ayanay imettizayssa be7idi Phexroosassinne Yohannisas miishshe ekki yiidi,
«Ta iza bolla ta kushe woththizaadey wuri Xillo Ayana ekkana mala hayssa mala godateth taaska immite» giin,
Phexroosi izas zaaridi, «Xoossa imota ne miishshan shammana qoppida gishshas neni ne miishshara issife dhaya.
Ne wozinay Xoossa sinththan suure gidontta gishshas nees hayssa ha oosozan gishay woykko qaaday deenna.
Hayssa ne iitateththaa gishshas ha7i elle maaroteththan gela; ne wozina qofaa nees atto gaanaakko nees Goda woossa.
Gaasoykka neni iitateththan kumidayssinne makkallan qashetta uttidayssi taas beettees» gides.
Simoonikka zaaridi, «Intte gida yo7otappe aykkoyka ta bolla gakkontta mala taas Godaa woossite» gides.
Phexroosinne Yohannisi Godaa qaala markkattidayssafenne qonccisi yootidayssafe guye daro Samaariya gutatan mishiraachcho qaalaa sabbakishe Yerusalaame simmida.
Piliphoosi Xammaqida Tophphiya Gundula Addeza
Godaa kiitanchchay Piliphoosa «Denda! Yerusalaameppe duge baggara gede Gaaza efiza bazzo ogera ba» gides.

Izikka dendi bides; Hindeko geetettiza Tophphiyappe gidida kawoya ba keeththaninne ba kawoteththan diza ubba miishshaa bolla alaafeteththan woththida issi Tophphiya dere gundula asi izara gaaggides; he addezi Xoossas goynnana Yerusalaame bides.
Izi heeppe simmishe para-gaaren uttidi nabe Isayaasa maxaafa nababees.
Ayanay Piliphoosa, «Ba! Gede para-gaarezakko shiiqa» gides.
Piliphoosikka eesotidi para-gaarezakko biidi addezi nabe Isayaasa maxaafa nababishin siyidi «Hessi ne nababizayssi nees gelizee?» gides.
Gundula addezikka «Tana erisiza asi baynda ta wostta eroo?» gides. Izikka gede iza gaarezan gelidi iza achchan uttana mala woossides.
Izi nababiza maxaafay,
Gundula addezikka zaaridi Piliphoosa, «Nabezi hayssa oona gishshas gizee? Ba gishshas gizeyee? Woykko hara asa gishshas gizee? Hayyana, taas yootarkkii!» gides.
Piliphoosikka ba doona doydi he maxaafappe doommidi Yesusa Mishiraachcho qaala gishshas markkattides.
Istti issife bishe haaththi dizaso gakkida; addezikka, «Hekko haaththi hayssan dees; histtiin ta xammaqettontta mala tana diggizay aazee?» gides.
Piliphoosikka, «Ne kumeththa wozinappe ammanikko xammaqettana dandayaasa» gides. Addezikka, «Yesus Kirstoosi Xoossa Naa gididayssa ta ammanays» gides.
Addezi para-gaarezi eqqana mala azaziin nam7ay issife haaththan wodhdhiin Piliphoosi addeza xammaqides.
Istti haaththaafe kezishin Xoossa Ayanay Piliphoosa denththi efides; addezi hessafe guye iza beyibeenna; gido attiin ufayssan ba oge bides.
Hessafe guye Piliphoosi Azaxoone geetettizason beettides; Qisaariya geetettizaso gakkanaas izi biza oge bolla katama ubbaan mishiraachcho qaala sabbakides.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo 37 bolla diza qofaa gujjeettes; issi issoti qasseka qofaa oykkibeettenna.
